changelog:
Initial release of shangan-gongkao skill:

- Organizes Chinese civil-service exam prep materials, including for 国考、省考、事业编、行政执法.
- Builds personalized study plans (7–60 days), daily checklists, and review tables.
- Extracts and summarizes methods for 行测、申论, with practical formula sheets and essay templates.
- Arranges mock exams, tracks wrong questions, and offers targeted review.
- Prioritizes using the learner’s own materials and cites local sources for traceability.
summary: Work with Chinese civil-service exam preparation materials. Use when learners ask to organize 公考资料, build 国考/省考/事业编/行政执法 study plans, extract 行测/申论 methods,...
